body: Both items assumed blockers that no longer apply. libsdl2-dev is installed (dpkg -l confirms), GOWORK=off CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./cmd/pitviper builds a real working binary. origin/PITVIPER remote already exists on GitHub and main is in sync, no push needed. Closing both with evidence, no new work required.
title: S127-03 + S127-04 both stale: SDL2 already installed, build clean; GitHub remote already exists and synced
